name: Isabella Rodriguez
title: Junior iOS Developer
summary: Enthusiastic Junior iOS Developer with a strong foundation in Swift and Xcode, eager to contribute to dynamic mobile development teams. Proven ability to create user-centric applications, optimize performance, and collaborate effectively throughout the development lifecycle.

Optimized app performance by refactoring existing code, reducing launch time by 15% and memory usage by 10%.
Collaborated with a cross-functional team of 5 to implement new UI/UX designs, resulting in a 20% increase in user engagement.
Participated in code reviews and contributed to documentation, enhancing code quality and team efficiency.
Assisted senior developers in building and testing new modules for an internal productivity tool, used by 200+ employees.
Implemented push notification functionality using Firebase, leading to a 25% improvement in user retention for specific features.
Debugged and resolved 30+ reported bugs across various app versions, improving overall application stability.
Designed and developed a simple habit-tracking application for personal portfolio, receiving 100+ downloads on TestFlight.
Integrated third-party APIs for weather data, enhancing application functionality and user experience.
